title: Exact CW32L052 factory-LSI SYSCLK independent runtime integration review

selected_own_manual_pages: RM168/169/175 AUTOTRIM target ownership and native prescaler

checks.finding: Accepted. LSI dispatch precedes the existing LSE/auxiliary/monitor/source-capture paths. Stage69 backend lines have zero removals; only eight expected insertion hunks. Non-LSI target bodies remain intact, apart from the intentional exact-L052 RTC rate-only provenance compatibility change.

Accepted. Frequencies performs no MMIO; validates LSI board/rate bounds, selected final buses, configured factory HSI at final divisors and fixed HSI /6 escape without post-fault bus credit. Fixed 1 MHz divisibility refusal remains before singleton acquisition and RCC work.
Accepted. HSI 0x00100A00 and LSI 0x00100A02 are each read once as aligned u16. Raw 0xffff refuses before native masking; zero is allowed. SDK SystemInit execution is not assumed.

Accepted. Complete normalized CR0/CR1/IER, oscillator words, coherent dual-ready, relevant sticky faults, SYSCTRL4 pending and immutable cold/live-ready/live-starting class precede gate inspection. Two complete consumer/pad passes compare fixed fields and original gate/reset tags; matching cold trim skips no proof.

Accepted. Native RTC CR0/CR1 except WINDOW/CR2/COMPEN; AUTOTRIM complete CR; all three UART CR2 words using sorce(); five GPIO FILTER words; full GPIOC AFRL/PC4; global MCO; LVD controls; work-gated LCD/LPTIM controls. Reserved source/mode/direct-AF encodings refuse; the positive own timer/MCO root appendix closes indirect paths.

Accepted. AUTO always refuses, enabled calibration refuses independently of SRC, mode must be defined, enabled Timer requires native raw PRS1..15. HSI change additionally refuses enabled AUTOTRIM Timer SRC0 or enabled LVD digital filter using HSIOSC.

Accepted. Off LCD/LPTIM gates are never enabled and their locals are never read. On paths bracket gate/reset identity; cold LCD requires EN0 and BUMP0 independently; cold LPTIM requires EN0 and completed ARST1/SRST1. No stop/reset/trigger/pump writes manufacture admission.

Accepted. Central inspection buffers semantics through restoration. Failed restoration outranks enable failure; independent original-gate mismatch precedes relevant observed external fault, reset/identity and semantic refusal. Work-gate drift is ownership refusal without attempted restoration.

Accepted. Pending source/parameter writes allow only exact old-or-target normalized words. Non-owned identity and faults are checked first, acknowledged target becomes the sole expectation, and arbitrary third values refuse. HSIEN0 acknowledgement permits documented ready-high in-flight stop before a separate dual-low check.

Accepted. Final stopped trim proof and separate request-edge proof precede permanent LSIEN. No later LSI parameter write or LSIEN clear occurs. Before request, LSIRDY and pending equal entry; afterward observed set bits and ready state are sticky. Other source phases never relax permanent LSI readiness.

Accepted. Mismatching inherited HSI is never enabled or selected as a bridge. Established factory LSI is selected directly under guards before HSI stop, trim-only update and restart. Factory HSI is then explicitly selected and only its documented divider changes.

Accepted. Full normalized native pad words and gate/reset are preserved. A separate permanent GPIOF gate enable is verified before pad writes. Only projected PF0 or PF0/PF1 input/pull/interrupt/open-drain/filter/AF/analog/lock deltas update expectation. No fresh raw snapshot rebases ownership.

Accepted. Enabled inherited HSE is preserved without stop/restart. Requested live parameters and pads must match; retained RTC HSE aliases/AUTOTRIM HSE ownership require ready requested HSE. Only genuinely cold explicitly requested HSE is configured and started under full per-attempt checks.

Accepted. Requested live LSE retains exact parameters/pads and existing LSECCS. Requested cold LSE uses target-only strict reset-like RTC, output-route, observer, consumer and pad checks, with two equal reset snapshots and controls read before calendar fields. No legacy preflight/start/verify or Boolean admission shortcut is used. The saved strict image is rechecked on every later full pass, including all waits and final verification, after exact known pad deltas.

Accepted. All source/pad/parameter work finishes before final buses on qualified factory HSI. Final WAIT covers max LSI HCLK/configured HSI HCLK and fixed /6 escape. P9 modifies only SYSCLK to LSI. After that edge no CR0, oscillator, request, divider, Flash or detector-policy write occurs; only readback and allowed temporary inspection gates remain. Last hardware observation is normalized CR0.

Accepted. Errors publish no clocks. No compensating reset/stop/observer clearing or rollback is introduced. Failure may leave partial pad/gate/source/Flash state; reset or required LSE power reset before retry remains explicit. CPU progress and continuing source availability are assumptions, not guarantees.

Accepted. Exact3 LSI SYSCLK/HCLK/PCLK and RTC LSI aliases retain rate-only provenance under every SYSCLK. Existing ADC rejection precedes gate writes. Buffered complementary PWM calls the strict duration assertion before Timer::new_configured even for zero dead time. Board-qualified LSE and other families retain their prior qualification.

Accepted. All 16 actual main rows and their copied artifacts/logs/generated OUT_DIR snapshots were independently rehashed. The 10 exact-L052 generated snapshots share native helper block SHA-256 0ddac2e6d90299113a33d4aebdd6a7a8c58a603bd98077b7d2305519deebf674. Generic L052/L083 do not gain this target. C8 keeps AFR4 admission without a PC4 token.

Accepted. Eight ELF32 ARM files were independently parsed, verifying actual entry/reset vectors, initial stack, PT_LOAD records and configured Flash/RAM bounds against receipts. Static RAM headroom is reported only as address space remaining below the initial stack, not measured or worst-case call-stack usage.

Compilation/linking and static inspection only. No HAL tests, probes, harnesses, executable clock models, target runtime refusals, gate-failure injections, hardware timing/continuity/recovery or low-power validation were executed or claimed by this review. Clean replay had not run at main acceptance and requires a separate supplementary review.

resolved_findings.resolution: Draft !ARST/!SRST corrected to positive ARST/SRST; own RM237 and actual final generated output verified.
Saved cold auxiliary-LSE full image is rechecked in collect on every subsequent full pass; expected deltas remain derived, never sampled.
Historical main-v1 failed E0308 retained. Native prs().to_bits()!=0 preserves PRS1..15; all final main-v4 rows compile.

Four unused STABLE constants removed while all IR validations and actual parameter masks remain. GPIOC AFRL redundant initial assignment removed; actual once-before-use assignment and final generated correspondence verified.

clean_review: This immutable main acceptance does not claim clean generation, clean builds or deterministic repackaging. Bind those later results in an external supplementary receipt without rewriting this historical main record.
